highlights.title: Chart selection moved to Meal panel
changes: The chart's floating detail card was removed and the selected-point readout now appears in the Meal panel instead of on.
The selected time is shown on the chart's x-axis rather than inside the readout row.
Scrubbing no longer re-lays the chart canvas, so highlights and the readout update without covering data.
Hour labels were moved into a separate label strip that follows Dynamic Type and avoids overlapping the plot.

sources.title: new chart detailed view in MealPanel

highlights.title: Update device and sensor modules; require iOS 17.6
changes: Device and sensor integration modules were refreshed to newer upstream versions.
OmnipodKit was updated to include an improvement for mid-command disconnects.
Trio's minimum iOS deployment target was raised to iOS 17.6, so a newer iOS is required to run the app.

sources.title: nightscout/Trio#1465: Update submodules to current upstream

highlights.title: Tamer alarms and no more duplicate sounds
changes: Alarm tones were equalized so different alerts no longer vary wildly in loudness.
If the system alarm channel is already sounding an alert, the notification is posted silently to avoid the same sound播放.
Alarms no longer force the device volume to maximum and only raise it to a moderate floor when needed.
Alarm availability is checked early so alarms don't accidentally play twice before the app is ready.

highlights.title: Stop dropping display-only glucose readings
changes: Trio no longer drops glucose readings that are marked as display-only.
Display-only readings are now stored so they can be used by the loop.
Sensor-reported faulty readings are still withheld and not stored.
Libre 3/3+ sensors that previously had their display-only readings discarded will now have those readings accepted.

sources.title: nightscout/Trio#1512: Fix for Libre 3/3 Plus: Stop dropping display-only glucose readings

highlights.title: Improve telemetry reliability and privacy
changes: Telemetry uploads are now scheduled to prevent overlapping or duplicate attempts.
Failed telemetry tries are delayed with a one-hour retry backoff.
The app records the prior telemetry failure and includes that context in the next attempt.
If you opt out of full telemetry, the app will still send a minimal anonymous daily check-in with only version, install.
Telemetry requests now include app version and install ID headers and improved app ID parsing to reduce registration 오류.

items.title: Internal dependency-injection cleanup
changes: There are no user-facing feature or UI changes.
Internal service setup was simplified to remove unused injections and duplicate resolves.
Several background services are now created and shared by a central container instead of self-managing singletons.
Automated tests were added so missing or mis-scoped service registrations fail CI instead of causing launch-time issues.

sources.title: Clean up DI: dead injections, singletons into container

includedPullRequests.title: Refactor: Dependency Injection Hygiene
includedPullRequests.body:
## Summary

This PR tidies up dependency injection and adds tests to guard the container wiring.

- Dependency injection cleaned up by dropping unused `FetchGlucoseManager` injections and the orphaned `Router` resolve in `DeviceDataManager`, and dedupes eager resolves in `loadServices`. `TrioRemoteControl`, `TelemetryClient`, and `TelemetryAttestor` are now registered container-scoped instead of self-resolving static singletons, which removes the lazy-inject lock ceremony they required.
- Adds container resolution specific tests to check resolve of every eagerly loaded service and assert that the converted singletons stay identical across resolves. A missing or mis-scoped registration now fails in CI rather than at launch.

Blocked by #1300.

includedPullRequests.title: Feat/chart selection popover
includedPullRequests.body: This introduces a new style of the detailed popover that the chart has. It now uses GlassChrome and lives in the MealPanel. The clock now is showen in the x-axis where normaly the hour label live. - More coherent UI/UX design language with the use of GlassChrome. - Surrounding data points (BG's, SMB etc . ... ) around the probe in the chart are better viewable. - Cleaner, more minimalist Changes in MainChart architecture: 1. The floating SelectionPopoverView card is deleted; the readout renders as ChartSelectionRow in the Home meal slot instead, so it no longer covers the data under the finger. 2. The selection rule and highlight dots moved to a shell overlay, so scrubbing never re-lays the canvas. 3. Hour labels left the pane's axis for the shell's xAxisOverlay, which lets a scrub swap them for its own time label. 4. The label strip became its own zone, taken off chartHeight before the panes split, with its height measured from a template label so it follows Dynamic Type. 5. xPosition(for:) now applies the live-pinch transform, since shell overlays sit outside the canvas's scaleEffect and would otherwise drift.   Iphone se (3rd gen iOS 17) (text is on older version only for demonstrating iOS 17 and small form factor)

includedPullRequests.title: Various Alarm Adjustments / Fixes
includedPullRequests.body:
## Summary

 - Normalize alarm sounds. Addresses (perceived) loudness for iOS 26+ users. AlarmKit has no volume API, so the sound files were adjusted. iOS 26+ users still get alarms at ringtone settings volume.
  - Double-sound removes one of two overlapping sounds for anyone with Override Silence & Focus on (reported by @t1dude )
  - Volume floor (50% instead of 100%) only touches the AVAudioPlayer fallback, so it does nothing on iOS 26+ with AlarmKit-based alerts.

includedPullRequests.title: Fix for Libre 3/3 Plus: Stop dropping display-only glucose readings
includedPullRequests.body:
`isDisplayOnly` means the reading was shifted for visual consistency after calibration (LoopKit), not that it is unsafe to dose on: Loop keeps these samples and excludes them only from momentum and counteraction. The gate was LibreLoop-scoped, so Trio already dosed on Dexcom's display-only samples.

It never held either way: LibreLoop's backfill paths forward the same sensor minute with isDisplayOnly false, so a dropped reading re-entered unflagged. On Libre 3 Plus the actionability bit is stuck clear, so every reading was discarded and those users could not loop at all.

**Readings the sensor reports as faulty are still withheld by the driver.**

Fixes #1495 and similar reports.

includedPullRequests.title: Significantly improve telemetry reliability
includedPullRequests.body:
I noticed that server-side telemetry logs showed 50x more requests to /api/auth/ios/challenge (the pre-step for telemetry emit to get an updated token) than /checkin (the step which actually emits the telemetry).

This seems to be because of:
```
2026-09-13T21:08:43-0400 [Storage] PersistedProperty.swift - wrappedValue - 84 - DEV: ❌ [PersistedProperty:telemetryLastSentSha] Failed to read value: Error Domain=NSCocoaErrorDomain Code=260 "The file “telemetryLastSentSha.plist” couldn’t be opened because there is no such file." UserInfo={NSFilePath=/var/mobile/Containers/Data/Application/00958F68-8277-4CB6-9155-9B9FB463B695/Documents/telemetryLastSentSha.plist, NSURL=file:///var/mobile/Containers/Data/Application/00958F68-8277-4CB6-9155-9B9FB463B695/Documents/telemetryLastSentSha.plist, NSUnderlyingError=0x108f4a160 {Error Domain=NSPOSIXErrorDomain Code=2 "No such file or directory"}}
2026-09-13T21:08:47-0400 [Telemetry] TelemetryAttestor.swift - registerIfNeeded(baseURL:) - 90 - DEV: attestKey input: isSupported=true keyID.count=44 keyID.prefix=XXXXXXX hash.count=32 challenge.count=96 bundle=org.nightscout.XXXXXXX.trio
2026-09-13T21:08:49-0400 [Telemetry] TelemetryClient.swift - send(reason:) - 401 - DEV: register failed: unable to read application-identifier entitlement — will retry next cycle
```

This causes only the /api/auth/ios/challenge request to be made, and not /checkin, which is what actually stores the telemetry.

In this PR:

- Adds safer telemetry scheduling so cold launch, foreground, timer, and CGM background triggers cannot overlap or double-send. Add trigger context like cold_launch, foreground, timer, background_activity, build_change, or manual.
- Adds one-hour retry backoff after failed telemetry attempts so failures do not retry continuously.
- Records and reports the previous telemetry failure category on the next request.
- Adds App Attest identity/context headers to telemetry server requests:
    - X-Trio-Version
    - X-Trio-InstallId
- Improves App ID/provisioning profile parsing for forks, custom bundle IDs, TestFlight/sideload builds, and malformed profiles.
- Adds an opted-out daily anonymous heartbeat using an empty GET /anonymous, carrying only version/install/reason/failure context. This new light-telemetry allows us to track total users without any additional identifying information captured, and does NOT flow into the regular telemetry pipeline. It just lets us roughly estimate the total user count which has telemetry disabled via server side request count.
- Adds focused tests for send gating, retry backoff, URL/query construction, identity headers, App ID parsing, and anonymous request shape.


## Testing

On my personal build, I confirmed that the error above no longer occurs and I instead see:
